subject.title: fix(telegram): surface diagnostic warning when inline keyboard buttons silently dropped due to 64-byte callback_data limit

question: Should an over-limit Telegram callback remain a successful text-only delivery with an operator diagnostic, or must the message-tool result expose the missing keyboard to its caller?
rationale: The linked report concerns approval correctness because the agent receives ok:true and may proceed as if controls were delivered; source inspection cannot determine whether operator-only logging is the intended product contract.

options.title: Expose degradation to caller
options.body: Return a structured warning or failure indicating that requested keyboard controls were removed while preserving any intentionally delivered text.

options.title: Accept diagnostics-only behavior
options.body: Keep ok:true text-only delivery and treat the gateway warning as the supported operator signal, with the linked issue narrowed accordingly.

recommendation.title: Expose degradation to caller
recommendation.body: Return a structured warning or failure indicating that requested keyboard controls were removed while preserving any intentionally delivered text.
